default size selection is Village (aria-pressed)
clicking a different size button updates aria-pressed correctly
"Begin a settlement" button is enabled before generation
generation produces a dossier with name + tier + population
anon counter is bumped in localStorage after a generation
pipeline rail is visible after generation (How this was simulated)
"New" button after generation returns to a fresh state
anonymous user does NOT see the inline Save button (auth-gated)
soft cap: after DEFAULT_DAILY_CAP generations, hero swaps to "Sign in to continue"

no console errors during the happy path

suites.title: Tier 3.7 Flow B — auth modal + credits gating

specs.title: "Sign In" button is visible in the header for anonymous users
clicking Sign In opens the AuthModal in the signin view
AuthModal default view is signin (not signup)
AuthModal tab toggle switches to signup view + updates copy
AuthModal primary path is password: fields + CTA render with no clicks
signin shows "Remember me on this device" with no clicks
the email sign-in link is an explicit alternative below the form
requesting a sign-in link with an empty email does NOT make a network request
modal closes when the user clicks outside / close button
soft-cap "Sign in to continue" also opens AuthModal
after generation: anonymous Save attempt routes through auth (no silent save)
no console errors when opening + interacting with the AuthModal
